note: Podium deck edge (d, metres out from the roof's outer edge) and deck height (z, metres above the turf) by compass bearing. Read off 784 Google Earth hovers (2026-11-22; pod_jobs.py): rays at 7 m height every 5 deg from 100 to 340 on the solved oblique cameras. The edge is where the hovers step from the deck down a vertical wall to the street. 160-172: the deck widens to ~19.5 m (south plaza). 220-228: a ramp falls from the deck to ~4 m. 228-292: the deck runs out to ~25 m under the west buildings (west_jobs.py measures those).
